lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows along the lateral flank, with clusters being most densely packed in the area immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like arrangement of nodes, most visible in the mid-flank section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges traverse the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp light-to-dark vertical intensity gradient from the dorsal to ventral aspect of each ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, large V-shaped indentation is visible on the posterior trailing margin of the pectoral fin, consistent with physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, irregular distribution of small high-luminance spots across its visible dorsal surface, distinct from the ordered grid pattern of the lateral flank.
